[Unobtainium4/5] Use2000mB LIQUID helium to draw heat from the90mB melt during seeded crystal growth. The2000mB returned output is warm ordinary helium GAS, not liquid coolant. Native Supercooler1000gas→100liquid means it supplies only200mB of the next2000mB liquid charge;18000mB fresh gas and20cooler operations are still needed. At the basic collector/cooler settings that is560000FE steady supply,600000FE initially, before Vat mixing power. Output gas handling is useful recycling, not a free coolant loop. Native game volumes are not physical gas expansion; no maximum-cold temperature is enforced by heat:none.

[Unobtainium5/5] Hot pressure-bond one grown Unobtainium crystal with one existing SiC/SiC CMC powder on the final Shadow Steel Press. The ceramic composite is structural reinforcement, not a random chip. This differentiates the final material from Radiance-finished Vibranium and preserves one ingot per crystal. Revised first Shadow housing/tool bills use Vibranium, earlier Radiance machinery and first Quantum electronics, with no base/combined Unobtainium feed; the first-source audit is recorded separately. Never move first Quantum/Allthemodium to Shadow, which would recreate a cycle.

Balanced custom draft for Fuel Refinery. Sheet age: Space. Two lined process vessels, metered valves and one steel-casing base form the fuel-processing skid. Plastic surrounds the cool control/exterior, not the fireproof hot-zone lining. Preserve specialized function, existing output yield unless explicitly stated, and upstream completed recipes. This replaces only the listed native construction route when separately exported; no gameplay change now. Source: ad_astra:fuel_refinery.

User requested Advanced Precision Mechanism be removed from all Shadow Steel machine construction as too low-tier. Replace only its existing positions with Computing Mechanisms for coordinated control. The existing lower-tier actuator machine provides mechanical motion; existing sensors, controllers, structural parts and working head stay in the exact latest user positions. No extra ingredients or shape changes; no new runtime accuracy/energy mechanic. This is a new control-component revision, not blanket approval of other designs.

User-requested early post-Refined-Radiance orbital computer rebalance. Preserve four advanced computers, four engineering processors, four circuit boards and the 5x5 layout. Plastic corner covers surround advanced control circuits; four ordinary TFMG capacitors condition the electronics power around one Refined Radiance casing. Remove all ATM alloys, Ultimate circuits, Ultimate energy cubes and Industrial Star. Navigation electronics, not endgame manufacturing. Pending review; no gameplay export.
